newsitem.title: SWEDEN: SKF posts lower H1 but sees brighter outloook.
newsitem.headline: SKF posts lower H1 but sees brighter outloook.

text.p: The world's largest bearings manufacturer, Sweden's SKF, on Tuesday posted a lower profit for the first half of 1997 but painted a brighter outlook for its markets both in and outside Western Europe.

SKF reported a six month profit after financial items of 1.10 billion crowns against 1.48 billion a year ago with changes in foreign exchange rates boosting operating income by nearly 300 million crowns.
Sales rose seven percent to 18.75 billion crowns against 17.53 billion crowns a year earlier, helped by volumes rising four percent.
